scope: Historical experimental evidence. README.md is new publication context. Scores, assertions, and application behavior have not been repaired or revised.
preserved_exactly: Every included .patch and .diff, including known defective/incomplete exports
Exact case prompt.md and candidate/starter TASK.md
transformations: Only document/log/JSON path strings and Markdown links are normalized; changed JSON is serialized as UTF-8/LF.
Included local Markdown targets become relative links; excluded targets are labeled omitted with clickable formatting removed; workflow source links point to the pinned GitHub revision.

Historical hash and byte-count assertions remain original evidence, even when their referenced documents have been normalized. Compare original_sha256 against those historical hashes; published_sha256 validates this export.
Historical reports retain statements about original local Git commits and resources, which are not new claims that those resources are published.
Unchanged archived Python and patch bytes can contain original absolute paths; their fidelity takes precedence over path normalization.
execution: Run the two primary evaluation/<case>/evaluate.py programs directly against runs/<case>/<arm>/project. tools/ and Python scripts below artifacts/ are original archival source and may require the original layout, Git checkouts, host paths, or mutable run state; no claim is made that those orchestration/audit scripts run unchanged after relocation. Never run them against the archived result files.
credential_scope: Webhook authentication strings in fixture configuration and test/probe code are synthetic examples. No native transcripts or message history are included; usage-summary.json retains aggregate/per-agent counters only.

exclusion_categories.reason: Git internals or temporary Git index
generated benchmark dataset; generator and measured outputs retained
native history export; aggregate and per-agent usage metadata retained
workflow source repository referenced by immutable GitHub revision

manifest_scope: files lists every copied original artifact. Newly authored root README.md, PUBLICATION.json, .gitattributes, and .gitignore have no original artifact hash and are excluded from this source-to-publication manifest. Files under publication-verification/ are new publication checks, not copied original artifacts, and are also outside this original-to-published manifest.
